title: Safety Sieve: smoke hallmark tests and performance alarms for rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Build a compact, high-signal preflight layer called the 'Safety Sieve' that runs as part of release validation and canary rollouts. The Safety Sieve focuses on: 1) a small suite of deterministic 'hallmark' smoke tests that exercise critical inference paths (KV cache warmup, long-context sampling, streaming interruptions), 2) a lightweight perf alarm set that watches key percentiles and token-level cost deltas, and 3) fast regression checks against a 'golden checkset' of prompts with expected output properties. This ticket scopes the engineering work to design the test selection algorithm, implement the runtime hooks for fast smoke runs, and wire alerting to rollout gates so that failing sieves block progression.
acceptance_criteria:
- Safety Sieve runs as part of the preflight pipeline and completes within 3 minutes for the standard smoke profile.
- Smoke hallmark tests cover: KV cache correctness (warm/cold), streaming resume from partial fragments, multi-turn chat context behavior across model variants.
- Perf alarms trigger if 99th latency increases by >20% or cost-per-token increases by >15% compared to the baseline run.
- Golden checkset regression: text-quality score (BLEU/ROUGE-like proxy used internally) does not fall below threshold for >2 prompts.
- Failing sieve marks the release candidate 'Blocked' and opens an auto-ticket with artifacts (traces, perf snapshots, failing prompts).
- End-to-end integration tests exercising gate behavior and rollback orchestration exist in CI with synthetic upstream failures mocked.
tasks: Design hallmark smoke test taxonomy and select 12 prompts across short/long/interactive patterns
Implement a Safety Sieve runner that can be invoked in preflight and during canary with a low-cost execution profile
Instrument runtime hooks to export trace IDs, KV hit ratios, and token-level cost deltas for sieve runs
Define perf alarm thresholds and implement an aggregator that computes baseline deltas and P99 drift
Create golden-checkset evaluation harness and lightweight scoring proxy (fast heuristics, not full evals)
Wire Failure -> Blocked gate behavior in release orchestrator and auto-create incident artifacts (dashboard snapshot + PR link)
Add CI job to validate Safety Sieve runner against the canary staging image and a synthetic load generator
